effects.categorization: 4.0 has only shape generators — no separate effect_modes category like 5.0 added later.

port_plan_for_4_0.approach: Re-implement each of the 32 shape algorithms in Python as a pure function mapping (frame_index, params, audio_features) to a 320x200 paletted buffer.
simplest_first: lines, diag1..4, zigzags — trivial line-drawing, good for pipeline validation
harder: sweep variants — rotating radial with palette cycling interaction
streamer — likely a connected polyline particle trail

audio_reactivity_axes.palette_cycle_rate: all effects — hook to overall RMS energy
